p0_01_distinct_architectures.evidence: After removing configuration, population, request and transaction identifiers, A1, equal-service K1x8 and typed K8 have pairwise-distinct scheduled service projections; contributor service counts and dense commit hash are conserved.

p0_02_bounded_psum_residency.evidence: The byte boundary and 100 finite D3 stripes are present, but a replacement psum read can issue before its dirty victim has completed external eviction.

p0_03_weight_address_layout.evidence: K24/K25 arithmetic is corrected to banks [0,1], rows [48,48], but logical weight LRU entries do not own physical slots; distinct output-block weights alias the same bank/local address.

p1_01_external_input_descriptor_refill_c.evidence: Deleting source, descriptor, or weight-refill external transactions independently creates unresolved dependencies.  However refill and psum backing never create the corresponding local SRAM write/read actions.

p1_02_executable_oracles.evidence: Real M712 and M722 contributor/group functions execute and injected count mismatches fail, but an injected M722 storage stripe_count=999 is accepted and the actual dynamic storage model is not reconciled to a1_storage_plan.

p1_03_d1_fallback.evidence: All three configurations have the same charged full-shape D1 signature and 16632000 compute requests; D1 remains non-headline and decoder_complete=false.

p2_01_cycle_attribution.evidence: M768 mutually-exclusive cycle classes are inherited and remain conservation labels rather than per-port bottleneck attribution.

findings.title: Dirty psum slot reuse is not ordered after external eviction completion
findings.required_fix: Give evict/restore events explicit local slots and chain slot reuse through completed six-bank psum read -> external write, or external read -> six-bank psum write, before any replacement psum access.

findings.title: The nine-entry weight LRU has no physical slot mapping and aliases distinct output-block weights
findings.required_fix: Allocate one of nine physical tile slots, map all eight bank-local reads through that slot, charge external refill plus local 1R1W bank writes, and make refill/read dependencies prevent overwrite-before-use.

findings.title: M722 storage mismatches are not fail-closed
findings.required_fix: Either reconcile every actual stripe/backing count with a matching executable storage oracle, or explicitly narrow M722 to contributor/group checking and add a separately pinned M777 storage-traffic oracle.

findings.title: Backing/refill external traffic omits local SRAM port service
findings.required_fix: Emit and schedule the local psum/weight bank actions and include them in the same address/port timing ledger.

findings.title: Cycle classes remain non-port-specific attribution labels
